source.note: Wave-1 row 9 named the Quaternius Animated Animals dog and row 7 the Ultimate Animated Animals Shiba Inu (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge; Google Drive quota-blocked). Reachable free dogs compared: the Animal Pack Vol.2 dog (OpenGameArt, CC0) has one material with no face marks and only Idle and Walking; the OpenGameArt Jack Russell (CC0) has no clips; 'Character Dog' (CC-BY-3.0) bakes all clips into one action; Benny the Rottweiler is CC-BY-SA. This is Quaternius's pug from the same author: a dark mask and ears that read at a glance, and six clips. Its .blend is used because the pack's Pug.fbx carries only Idle and Jump. Height 0.35 m is a real pug to the top of the head; it is a small breed, not the medium dog the plan imagined, and there is no Shiba in any reachable free pack.
